qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Rural geographic monopoly where ~50% of stores operate in towns with <5,000 residents lacking restaurant or grocery competition. 5th largest US pizza chain with ~60% prepared food gross margins and proven pricing power above inflation; 5Y median GAAP ROIC of 12.7% and tangible ROIC of 15.1%-17.8%. Primary erosion threats are long-term EV fleet adoption dampening fuel trips and rural population stagnation.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Dominant rural Midwest and Southern convenience hub operating as a local geographic monopoly where ~50% of stores reside in towns with populations under 5,000 lacking restaurant or grocery competition. High-margin prepared food (5th largest US pizza chain with ~60% gross margins) provides resilient pricing power above inflation. Insulated from AI disruption and structurally cushioned against rapid EV transition by rural driving dynamics and heavy fee-simple store ownership (~90%). Fortress balance sheet with 10.7x interest coverage and net debt repayable in 2.5 years of net income. [5-10Y g: store count growth 3.0% + inside traffic volume 1.5% + prepared food pricing 2.5% + mix shift 1.0% - fuel volume drag 0.5% + share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Owner EPS compounded at 18.0% CAGR from $4.48 in FY2016 to $19.16 in FY2025. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 12.71% and FY2025 tangible operating ROIC reached 17.83%. 10-year cumulative Owner FCF of $4.42B represents 115.5% conversion of GAAP Net Income ($3.83B), with TTM FCF conversion at 116.7%. Pristine balance sheet despite November 2024 acquisition of Fikes/CEFCO (198 stores, $1.15B): FY2025 Net Debt of $1.81B is 2.53x Net Income ($714.4M) and EBIT interest coverage is 10.7x ($1,033.7M EBIT vs $96.6M interest). Network of ~2,900 stores supported by self-distribution logistics (~75% inside goods) and over 9 million Casey's Rewards loyalty members.
